description: This file is a PHP source script for managing user roles in the TestLink project. It handles creating, editing, duplicating, and managing roles, including rendering templates, processing user input, and managing rights and permissions.

classes.name: tlRole
classes.description: Represents a user role, with methods to retrieve and write roles to the database, and to get associated users.

classes.name: tlRight
classes.description: Represents a permission or right that can be assigned to roles.

methods.name: getWebEditorCfg
methods.description: Retrieves configuration for a web editor component.

methods.name: require_web_editor
methods.description: Includes the appropriate web editor script based on the configuration type.

methods.name: testlinkInitPage
methods.description: Initializes the page context, such as database connection and permissions.

methods.name: init_args
methods.description: Initializes and sanitizes input parameters from the request.

methods.name: doOperation
methods.description: Performs create, update, or duplicate operations on roles based on user input.

methods.name: complete_gui
methods.description: Prepares the GUI data structure based on current role and action.

methods.name: renderGui
methods.description: Renders the GUI template based on current action.

methods.name: I_PARAMS
methods.description: Initializes parameter object based on input definitions.

methods.name: TLS
methods.description: Translates a message key to a localized message.

methods.name: getRoleErrorMessage
methods.description: Gets error message based on role operation result.

methods.name: generateUniqueName
methods.description: Generates a unique name for duplicated roles.

methods.name: init_labels
methods.description: Initializes label strings for the interface.
